wagon_requisition_levy.name: Wagon Levies on the Line of March
wagon_requisition_levy.observation: When the army passes, each town along the road must send wagons, teams and drivers on to the next halt.
wagon_requisition_levy.social_consequence: Towns lose their carts in harvest month and curse the army's road.

camel_displaces_cart.name: Camels Replace Carts
camel_displaces_cart.observation: In the dry country the carters sell their wheels; a string of camels needs no paved road and no bridge.

fee_kept_post_stations.name: Fee-Kept Post Stations
fee_kept_post_stations.observation: Where the ruler's post has lapsed, a landholder keeps horses at the old station and charges each rider who changes there.

sewn_plank_hulls.name: Sewn-Plank Hulls
sewn_plank_hulls.observation: Planks stitched together with coconut-fibre cord give, rather than split, when the boat is run through the surf onto the beach.

road_to_water_freight_shift.name: Freight Turns to the Water
road_to_water_freight_shift.observation: The paved roads crack and no one mends them, so grain and stone now go by barge and coaster.
road_to_water_freight_shift.social_consequence: Inland towns far from any river wither as the carters vanish.

hired_caravan_guides.name: Hired Caravan Guides
hired_caravan_guides.observation: A guide who knows where the wells lie and which tribes take tolls is paid a share of the caravan's goods.

spaced_tenon_planking.name: Spaced-Tenon Planking
spaced_tenon_planking.observation: Shipwrights cut fewer tenons, set wider apart, since the frames now carry more of the hull's strain.

lateen_merchant_rig.name: Lateen Merchant Rig
lateen_merchant_rig.observation: A long slanting yard carries a three-cornered sail that lets merchantmen work along the coast against a side wind.

coastal_cabotage_trade.name: Coastal Carrying Trade
coastal_cabotage_trade.observation: Small ships run from port to port, selling part of the cargo and taking on more at each.

rigid_horse_collar.name: Rigid Horse Collar
rigid_horse_collar.observation: A padded frame sits on the horse's shoulders, so it can pull with its full strength without choking.
rigid_horse_collar.ability_reason: A horse in a collar can draw a plough or a loaded wagon that once needed a team of oxen, and draw it faster.
rigid_horse_collar.social_consequence: Farms that can feed horses outpace those that cannot, and oats claim a share of every field.

estate_carrying_services.name: Estate Carrying Services
estate_carrying_services.observation: Tenants owe carting days, hauling grain and wine between an estate's scattered farms and its hall.

pass_hospices.name: Pass Hospices
pass_hospices.observation: At the top of the pass a house of brothers keeps fire, bread and dogs for travelers caught by the snow.

remittance_certificates.name: Remittance Certificates
remittance_certificates.observation: A merchant pays silver into a provincial office and carries only a sealed paper to collect it at the capital.

clinker_shell_construction.observation: Each plank overlaps the one below and is riveted through, so the hull is built up as a light, strong shell before any frame goes in.
clinker_shell_construction.ability_reason: Light, flexible clinker hulls ride out open water and can be beached anywhere, carrying crews and cargo far beyond the coast.

treadle_paddle_boats.name: Treadle Paddle Boats
treadle_paddle_boats.observation: Men treading a shaft turn paddle wheels on the boat's sides and drive it upstream without sail or oar.

watertight_bulkheads.name: Watertight Bulkheads
watertight_bulkheads.observation: Wooden walls divide the hold into sealed compartments, so one holed plank floods only one of them.

single_horse_shafts.name: Single-Horse Shafts
single_horse_shafts.observation: Two poles fixed to the cart run along the horse's flanks, so a single animal can both pull it and back it.

keeled_sailing_longships.name: Keeled Sailing Longships
keeled_sailing_longships.observation: A true keel under a clinker hull lets a single square sail drive the ship across open sea.
keeled_sailing_longships.ability_reason: Crews can now cross open water for days at a stretch, trading and raiding across seas that once walled them in.
keeled_sailing_longships.social_consequence: Coasts that were safe behind open water now watch the horizon for sails.

seasonal_beach_emporia.name: Seasonal Beach Markets
seasonal_beach_emporia.observation: Where ships winter at a river mouth, a market of booths grows on the beach each spring and melts away each autumn.

land_finding_signs.name: Land-Finding Signs
land_finding_signs.observation: Out of sight of land, pilots watch for shore birds, a change in the swell and clouds piled over an unseen island.

great_desert_caravans.name: Great Desert Caravans
great_desert_caravans.observation: Thousands of camels march together across the sand, watering at wells that lie days apart.

portage_hauling_stations.name: Portage Hauling Stations
portage_hauling_stations.observation: At each portage, hired teams drag the boats on rollers from one river to the next for a set fee.

whippletree_evener.name: Whippletree Evener
whippletree_evener.observation: A pivoting bar behind each horse evens the pull, so no animal carries the load for its teammate.

landholder_bridge_duty.name: Road and Bridge Duty
landholder_bridge_duty.observation: Every holder of land owes days each year to mend the roads and bridges that cross it.
landholder_bridge_duty.social_consequence: Farmers resent road days in planting time, but the bridges no longer fall.

open_sea_cargo_ships.name: Open-Sea Cargo Ships
open_sea_cargo_ships.observation: A broad hull with a half-deck and a deep hold carries cattle, timber and grain across open sea.

windward_luff_spar.name: Windward Luff Spar
windward_luff_spar.observation: A spar pushed out from the bow holds the sail's leading edge taut, so the ship can beat against the wind.

hacksilver_trade.name: Hack-Silver Trade
hacksilver_trade.observation: Coins, bracelets and plate are cut up and weighed again at each market on the northern rivers.

winter_sledge_roads.name: Winter Sledge Roads
winter_sledge_roads.observation: When the rivers freeze, sledges run along the ice and across marsh that no one can cross in summer.

nailed_horseshoes.name: Nailed Horseshoes
nailed_horseshoes.observation: Iron shoes nailed to the hoof let horses work on stone roads and wet ground without going lame.
nailed_horseshoes.ability_reason: Horses shod with iron keep their feet on long roads and wet fields, so riders, posts and teams travel farther without resting their animals.

pole_star_latitude_tablet.name: Pole-Star Latitude Tablet
pole_star_latitude_tablet.observation: A pilot holds a knotted cord and tablet up to the pole star and keeps the ship at the star's known height.

battened_panel_sails.name: Battened Panel Sails
battened_panel_sails.observation: Cane battens stiffen the sail, and it is shortened panel by panel from the deck.

voyage_victualling_scales.name: Voyage Victualling Scales
voyage_victualling_scales.observation: The purser reckons bread, water and salt meat per sailor per day and loads the ship for the length of the voyage.

packhorse_carrier_trains.name: Packhorse Carrier Trains
packhorse_carrier_trains.observation: Hired carriers lead strings of packhorses over upland tracks too steep for wagons.

tandem_file_harness.name: Tandem Harness
tandem_file_harness.observation: Horses hitched one in front of another haul a heavy load through narrow lanes a wide team could not pass.

carrier_stage_tariffs.name: Carrier Stage Tariffs
carrier_stage_tariffs.observation: A carrier's charge is fixed per pack and per stage, so the merchant knows the cost before he loads.

funded_traveling_merchant.name: Funded Traveling Merchant
funded_traveling_merchant.observation: A merchant who stays at home puts up the money; his partner carries the goods, and they split the profit.

carvel_frame_construction.observation: Shipwrights raise the frames first and fasten the planks edge to edge upon them, so a hull can be as large as its frames allow.
carvel_frame_construction.ability_reason: Frame-first hulls can be built bigger and mended plank by plank, so large ships can be laid down to a plan.

horse_transport_ships.name: Horse Transports
horse_transport_ships.observation: Ships with stalls in the hold and a door in the stern put horses ashore on a beach ready to ride.

wheel_drag_shoes.name: Wheel Drag Shoes
wheel_drag_shoes.observation: An iron shoe chained under the rear wheel locks it on a steep hill, so the wagon cannot run away.

merchant_safe_conducts.name: Merchant Safe-Conducts
merchant_safe_conducts.observation: A sealed letter from the ruler lets a merchant pass through a hostile land unharmed.

guarded_trade_fairs.name: Guarded Trade Fairs
guarded_trade_fairs.observation: Merchants from many lands meet at a fixed season under a guarded peace, and all debts are settled on the fair's last days.
guarded_trade_fairs.ability_reason: A fair that gathers the far merchants in one place, at one time, under one peace draws goods from half the world.
guarded_trade_fairs.social_consequence: The fair town grows rich and crowded, and its fever season arrives with the merchants.

merchant_bale_marks.name: Merchant Bale Marks
merchant_bale_marks.observation: Each merchant paints or stamps his mark on his bales and casks, so lost goods can be claimed at any port.

floating_needle_compass.name: Floating Needle Compass
floating_needle_compass.observation: A needle rubbed on lodestone and floated on a straw in a bowl of water swings round to point north.
floating_needle_compass.ability_reason: Pilots can hold a course under cloud and in fog, when neither sun nor star can be seen.

carrier_loss_liability.name: Carrier Liability
carrier_loss_liability.observation: A carrier who loses or spoils goods on the road must pay their value, so carriers guard their loads.

bridge_brotherhoods.name: Bridge Brotherhoods
bridge_brotherhoods.observation: A brotherhood of townsmen gathers alms and tolls to keep the great bridge standing.

horse_towed_barges.name: Horse-Towed Barges
horse_towed_barges.observation: Horses on the towpath draw barges upstream that once needed a gang of men hauling on ropes.

written_sea_customs.name: Written Sea Customs
written_sea_customs.observation: The customs of the sea are written down: what the master owes the crew, and who bears the loss of cargo thrown overboard in a storm.

horse_freight_wagons.name: Horse Freight Wagons
horse_freight_wagons.observation: Four-wheeled wagons behind horses cover in a day what an ox cart covered in two.

bills_of_exchange.name: Bills of Exchange
bills_of_exchange.observation: A merchant pays coin in one city and receives a paper that a partner abroad must honour, in his own coin, on a set day.
bills_of_exchange.ability_reason: Traders can move payment across seas without carrying silver, so the far trade grows past the coin in hand.
bills_of_exchange.social_consequence: Townsmen who cannot read the bills distrust a wealth that lives on paper.

endowed_day_stage_inns.name: Day-Stage Inns
endowed_day_stage_inns.observation: Inns endowed by pious gift stand a day's ride apart along the great roads.

cable_ferries.name: Cable Ferries
cable_ferries.observation: A ferry hauled along a rope stretched across the river crosses safely even in flood.

day_walk_market_spacing.name: Day-Walk Market Spacing
day_walk_market_spacing.observation: Charters space the markets a day's walk apart, so every village can reach one, sell, and walk home by night.

sternpost_rudder.name: Sternpost Rudder
sternpost_rudder.observation: A rudder hung on iron pins at the stern steers a big ship far better than an oar over the side.
sternpost_rudder.ability_reason: Large ships can be steered in heavy seas, so hulls can grow deeper and taller without losing control.

high_sided_bulk_ships.name: High-Sided Bulk Ships
high_sided_bulk_ships.observation: A flat-bottomed, high-sided ship with a straight sternpost carries grain, wine and cloth in bulk and is hard to board.
high_sided_bulk_ships.ability_reason: One high-sided ship carries what a fleet of small ones did, so grain, timber and wine move by sea at a fraction of the cost.

deck_windlass.name: Deck Windlass
deck_windlass.observation: A barrel turned by handspikes on the deck raises the anchor and hoists the heavy yards.

realm_relay_post.name: Realm Relay Post
realm_relay_post.observation: Relay stations a day's ride apart span the realm, and a rider with a metal pass takes fresh horses at each.
realm_relay_post.ability_reason: Orders and reports cross the whole realm in days, so a distant province can be ruled and its generals kept informed.
realm_relay_post.social_consequence: Villages near the stations must feed the post horses and riders, and they hate the burden.

annual_bulk_fleets.name: Annual Bulk Fleets
annual_bulk_fleets.observation: The wine and salt ships sail together once a year to fixed markets, safer in company.

public_weighhouses.name: Public Weighhouses
public_weighhouses.observation: Bulk goods must be weighed on the town's great beam, for a fee, before they are sold.

reef_points.name: Reef Points
reef_points.observation: Short ties sewn across the sail let the crew bundle part of it to the yard as the wind rises.

cask_tonnage_rating.name: Cask Tonnage Rating
cask_tonnage_rating.observation: A ship is rated by how many standard wine casks it carries, and dues are charged by that number.

reservoir_fed_summit_canals.name: Summit Canals
reservoir_fed_summit_canals.observation: A canal climbs over a ridge, its summit reach fed by reservoirs dammed in the hills above.
reservoir_fed_summit_canals.social_consequence: Millers above the reservoirs lose their water to the boatmen below.

compass_bearing_sea_charts.name: Compass-Bearing Sea Charts
compass_bearing_sea_charts.observation: Charts drawn with lines of compass bearing run from harbor to harbor, with the coasts traced true between them.
compass_bearing_sea_charts.ability_reason: Pilots can set a course between distant harbors from a drawn chart rather than from memory alone.

bills_of_lading.name: Bills of Lading
bills_of_lading.observation: The master signs a list of every bale taken aboard, and the merchant keeps a copy ashore.

auctioned_galley_convoys.name: Auctioned Galley Convoys
auctioned_galley_convoys.observation: The state builds the merchant galleys and auctions each voyage's charter to merchants on fixed routes.

dry_compass_card.name: Dry Compass Card
dry_compass_card.observation: A needle on a pivot beneath a card painted with the winds turns in a dry box, and the steersman reads his course off the card.
dry_compass_card.ability_reason: A compass read at a glance in any weather lets ships steer long courses by night and through storms.

staple_market_towns.name: Staple Towns
staple_market_towns.observation: Goods passing through the staple town must be unloaded and offered for sale there for three days.
staple_market_towns.social_consequence: Merchants resent the forced halt, but the staple town grows fat.

sandglass_dead_reckoning.name: Sandglass Dead Reckoning
sandglass_dead_reckoning.observation: A sandglass turned each half-watch and a tally of the ship's speed let the pilot reckon how far she has run.

licensed_pilots.name: Licensed Pilots
licensed_pilots.observation: Only a pilot sworn and licensed by the harbor may bring a ship over the bar.

merchant_courier_schedules.name: Merchant Courier Schedules
merchant_courier_schedules.observation: Couriers leave on fixed days between the trading cities, carrying letters, prices and bills.

merchant_route_handbooks.name: Merchant Route Handbooks
merchant_route_handbooks.observation: A merchant's handbook lists the roads, tolls, coins and measures of every market from here to the far sea.

premium_sea_insurance.name: Premium Sea Insurance
premium_sea_insurance.observation: For a premium paid in advance, underwriters promise the value of a cargo lost at sea.

harbor_ship_registers.name: Harbor Ship Registers
harbor_ship_registers.observation: The harbor keeps a register of every ship, its owners and its master.
